Class Collisions

java.lang.Object
utils.Collisions
public class Collisions extends Object
Utility class for detecting collisions between players.

This class provides a method to check if a Players object (e.g., an enemy or player) would collide with any other players when moving in a specific direction.

  • Method Details

    • collisions

      public static String collisions(ArrayList<Players> players, String direction, Players toCheck, int tileSize)
      Checks for collisions between a given player and a list of other players in a specified direction.

      The method calculates the bounding box of the toCheck player based on its current position and the tileSize. It then checks if this bounding box would intersect with any other player's bounding box when moving in the given direction.

      The returned string indicates the type of collision:

      • "up-player", "down-player", "left-player", "right-player": collision with the player named "Jean-Guy" in the specified direction.
      • "enemy": collision with any other player (not "Jean-Guy").
      • "ok": no collision detected.
      Parameters:
      players - the list of all Players objects to check collisions against
      direction - the movement direction ("up", "down", "left", "right") to check
      toCheck - the Players object whose movement is being checked
      tileSize - the size of a tile, used to calculate the bounding box for collision
      Returns:
      a String indicating the type of collision ("up-player", "down-player", "left-player", "right-player", "enemy", or "ok")
